title: Avoid redecoding settled causal completion history on every scan cycle
outcome: Settled originals can be skipped cheaply during periodic scans while boot and pending-row validation preserve the original private custody and receipt invariants.
acceptance: Behavioral or instrumented evidence shows a settled multi-target original is skipped without repeated full settlement/request reconstruction during periodic scans.
Pending recovery and boot validation remain complete, malformed rows do not grant credit, and no parallel completion registry or unsupported schema field is introduced.
